title: John Abraham Acquires ₹84 Crore Bungalow in Mumbai's Bandra West
excerpt: The actor's latest real estate purchase on St Martin Road adds a premium freehold property to his growing portfolio, joining a penthouse and rental investments in the neighbourhood.
body:
• John Abraham has purchased a freehold bungalow on St Martin Road in Bandra West for ₹84 crore, registered on July 14, 2026.
  • The property sits on a 1,017-square-metre plot with a built-up area of approximately 193 square metres and an outhouse.
  • This is his second major Bandra real estate acquisition after a ₹75 crore bungalow in Khar in December 2023.
  • Bandra West remains Mumbai's most sought-after residential address for Bollywood celebrities and high-net-worth individuals.

Bollywood actor and producer John Abraham has made another significant real estate move, acquiring a premium bungalow in Mumbai's Bandra West for a registered consideration of ₹84 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by Liases Foras.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=07H2x2GjN6U

The transaction, officially registered on July 14, 2026, adds a freehold property on St Martin Road — one of Mumbai's most coveted residential addresses — to Abraham's growing portfolio. The locality is home to several prominent personalities from the entertainment industry and commands some of the highest property prices in the country.

Property Details

The property stands on a 1,017.60-square-metre plot and includes an existing bungalow with a built-up area of approximately 193.12 square metres, along with an outhouse measuring around 31.50 square metres. The freehold nature of the acquisition — relatively rare in Mumbai, where most properties are leasehold — makes the deal particularly notable.

This marks Abraham's second major real estate purchase in the Bandra-Khar corridor. In December 2023, he acquired a 13,138-square-foot bungalow named Nirmal Bhuvan on Linking Road in Khar for approximately ₹75 crore, a property with redevelopment potential.

Celebrity Real Estate in Bandra

Bandra West continues to attract Bollywood's biggest names. The neighbourhood is home to Shah Rukh Khan's Mannat, Salman Khan's Galaxy Apartments, and Ranbir Kapoor's family bungalow Krishnaraj. Abraham himself lives in a sea-facing penthouse at Hiten Apartments on Shirley Rajan Road, and earlier this year rented out three residential units in the area for a cumulative ₹4.3 crore over a five-year lease.

For NRIs watching Indian real estate, Bandra West exemplifies the premium end of Mumbai's market, where freehold bungalow prices have appreciated steadily even as the broader market has seen cycles of correction. Celebrity purchases often signal confidence in the locality's long-term value.

Abraham's Business Portfolio

Beyond acting, Abraham has built a diverse business portfolio spanning real estate, fitness, and sports ownership. He co-owns NorthEast United FC in the Indian Super League and has interests in food and beverage and lifestyle ventures. His recent filmography includes the political thriller The Diplomat and the action film Tehran.
